about: The Shipping Corporation of India Limited, a marginal liner shipping company, engages in the business of transporting goods in India. It operates through Liner, Bulk, Tanker, and Technical & Offshore segments. The company's fleet includes bulk carriers, crude oil tankers, product tankers, container vessels, passenger-cum-Cargo vessels, LPG carriers, and offshore supply vessels.
